protocol.state_policy: Solved + original independent certificate. Inaccurate candidate retained; choose a separately certified alternative native solve, never accept by status alone.
protocol.change_reason: V3 ordinary B2 Q1 error 2.202% fails 2%; V3 refined 1.754% passes. Preserve failure; select pre-existing tighter configuration and add another refinement.
protocol.budget_policy: Carry all V1 and V3 experimental costs forward; no new category allocation or per-run budget increase. At most one stricter-configuration campaign; no further retuning after V4.
protocol.entry_fix: V4 used the V3 formal whitelist and both finer jobs were rejected before initialization. V4A validates the complete V4 contract in a separate versioned entry and calls the identical frozen loop. No change to any numerical parameter, kernel or holdout.
